Incident history (7)

📅 2025-05-13 airstrike INC-127
Hospital severely damaged and rendered non-functional; evacuation hub disrupted; critical infrastructure (including oxygen lines and sewage systems) destroyed; hospital effectively taken out of service. Nineteen people were reportedly killed and more than 40 were injured, including four journalists. Following the attack, Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) operating at the hospital had to suspend the outpatient consultations and reduce the number of MSF staff in the facility.

The European Gaza Hospital in Khan Younis was hit by Israeli airstrikes targeting its internal yards and surrounding area. The strikes caused major structural damage and led to the collapse of key medical infrastructure. The hospital, which served as a major medical evacuation and treatment hub, became non-functional. Evacuation operations were ongoing at the time, and WHO later confirmed coordinated evacuees were not harmed during the evacuation process itself, despite the attack on the facility.

19 killed40 injured
Sources: 🔗 ochaopt 🔗 ochaopt 🔗 bbc

📅 2024-08-01 drone strike - vicinity INC-126
No confirmed casualties reported

The area around the Gaza European Hospital in Khan Younis was reportedly struck by drones. The report notes no clear information on deaths or injuries from this incident.

Sources: 🔗 unocha
View full incident →
📅 2024-07-01 – 2024-07-02 evacuation INC-125
Hospital evacuated and became non-functional; patients and staff evacuated.

The Israeli military issued an evacuation order affecting eastern Khan Younis and Rafah. Although the European Gaza Hospital was later clarified as not directly included in the order, fear and prior experience caused patients and medical staff to flee. By 2 July, all patients and staff (about 320 people) had left, and the hospital became completely empty. Patients were transferred mainly to Nasser Medical Complex, which became overcrowded.

Sources: 🔗 ochaopt
View full incident →

📅 2023-12-21 – 2023-12-22 strikes-vicinity INC-123
hospital vicinity struck

The areas around Al Amal Hospital and European Gaza Hospital in Khan Younis were struck during ongoing hostilities. Shrapnel reportedly scattered into nearby medical facilities, causing fear and panic among patients and displaced people sheltering nearby.

Sources: 🔗 ochaopt
View full incident →
📅 2023-12-08 – 2023-12-10 Bombardment (Vicinity) INC-121
Access to healthcare impeded; ambulance attack injured paramedics; hospital operations affected amid ongoing bombardment

The vicinity of the European Gaza Hospital in Khan Younis was repeatedly bombarded for at least three consecutive days (8–10 December 2023), impeding access to healthcare for dozens of injured people. The hospital was sheltering about 70,000 internally displaced persons (IDPs). On 9 December, an ambulance near the hospital reportedly came under fire by Israeli forces.

2 health workers injured
Sources: 🔗 unocha 🔗 unocha
View full incident →
📅 2023-11-14 siege INC-122
The hospital had run out of water, affecting 400 patients and thousands of IDPs.

On 14 November, the Nursing Director at the European Gaza Hospital was quoted in a media outlet as stating that the hospital had run out of water. This would affect over 400 patients and thousands of IDPs sheltering on the premises.

Sources: 🔗 ochaopt

📍 Gaza European Hospital — Khan Younis, Khan Younis

Summary

The European Gaza Hospital in Khan Younis was hit by Israeli airstrikes targeting its internal yards and surrounding area. The strikes caused major structural damage and led to the collapse of key medical infrastructure. The hospital, which served as a major medical evacuation and treatment hub, became non-functional.
